dynamic_line: If you're offering.  Before everything went to hell, Jay was talking about going to some gun show.  There was a guy there who had managed to sneak some Russian gun into the US.  It was a massive deal for Jay, it was all he could talk about.  I know it's a long shot, but maybe that guy was already at the gun show?  If you find the gun you can keep it, but it would mean a lot to Jay if he could take a look.  All he wanted was to pull it apart and put it back together.

responses.text: I'll bring you back a souvenir.

dynamic_line: Sure, honey!  I'm always in need of more material!  What's the price, though?

responses.text: Well, how about 100 merch for every 70 pounds of metal…
